summary: @years17/n8n-nodes-helper-utils runs host reconnaissance at install and on require
details: The package's package.json declares a postinstall hook that spawns a child process to run `id` and `hostname` and writes the output to /tmp/pwned.txt on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The main entry (index.js) additionally executes `id; hostname; uname -a; ls -la /home; cat /etc/hostname` via child_process on any require/import of the module and writes results to /tmp/n8n_pwned.txt, running inside the host n8n process. A shipped n8n node's execute() further runs recon commands (`id; hostname; uname -a; ls -la /home; ls -la /`) and returns them as workflow output, with a `pwned: true` flag confirming the payload's intent. The package presents itself as an n8n utility-nodes helper, but its only functional code is host reconnaissance auto-executed at install and import time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
